CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.
   B. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
